edition.authority: Second Vatican Council; Pope Paul VI
edition.notes: The official Latin Acta constituent contains numbered articles 1-42 and the promulgation apparatus on printed pp. 947-990. Page 990 refers to the common subscriptions on pp. 941-946 and carries an editorial asterisk pointing to Paul VI's distinct 10 June 1966 motu proprio Munus Apostolicum; neither referenced constituent is part of the Decree's numbered body.
edition.title: Decretum de activitate missionali Ecclesiae Ad gentes

passages.context: The Decree's complete numbered Latin body, beginning with article 1 on printed p. 947 and ending with article 42 on printed p. 990 immediately before the promulgation formula.
passages.notes: The beginning, numbered sequence, article-42 endpoint, and transition to promulgation were checked against the exact Acta artifact. The passage excludes the promulgation apparatus, common subscriptions referenced on pp. 941-946, and the editorial reference to Munus Apostolicum; no complete diplomatic transcription or word-for-word image collation is claimed.
passages.reason: The rights record states that lawful project access to this artifact does not include redistribution from this repository.
passages.rights_basis: The Vatican portal Legal Notes, reviewed 2026-07-23 at https://www.vatican.va/content/vatican/en/legal-notes.html, limit portal content to personal and non-profit viewing and prohibit collection, reproduction, dissemination, or transfer without prior written authorization from the Dicastery for Communication. No repository redistribution permission was established.

alternate_titles: Decree on the Mission Activity of the Church
work.author: Second Vatican Council
work.description: The Second Vatican Council's Decree on the Mission Activity of the Church, solemnly promulgated by Pope Paul VI on 7 December 1965. It comprises numbered articles 1-42; edition records distinguish the Latin Acta witness from dated Vatican web delivery states and translations.
work.title: Ad gentes
